name: process_refund
description: Process a customer refund for an order. Requires the order ID, the refund amount in whole US dollars, and a reason. Optionally accepts an idempotency_key so that retrying the same operation never creates a duplicate refund. Refunds over the company limit are rejected by policy at the gateway, not by this tool.

order_id.description: The order ID to refund (for example ORD-123).

amount.description: Refund amount in whole US dollars (for example 250).

reason.description: Reason for the refund (for example 'defective item').

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key that makes retries safe. Reusing the same key returns the original refund instead of creating a new one.
